pullRequests.title: Drop the NTSC decomp submodule: NTSC-U built here, the NTSC decomp read at a pin
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: main
pullRequests.body:
The versions/ntsc submodule put 2,122 files of the NTSC decomp into every recursive clone. It goes. Nothing about matching changes: no new C, no ports.

NTSC-U is a version like PAL v1.00 and NTSC-J (tools/versions.py drops the submodule field). Its boot ELF and 19 level programs build byte-identical from assembly (20 of 20), with programs.tsv, boot_layout.json, a fresh map.tsv and our own report in progress/us/report.json (4,756 of 5,097 functions, 74.21% of code). version_sync.py check now…

pullRequests.title: feat(us): carry 64 definitions that build NTSC-U exactly
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: main
pullRequests.body:
version_sync.py run copies 64 existing PAL v1.00 and NTSC-J definitions into src/versions/us/, where they build NTSC-U byte for byte. No new C.

NTSC-U: 4,756 to 4,822 of 5,097 functions (76.10% of code)
version_build.py --version us: 20 of 20 programs match
version_sync.py check, gen_progress_report.py --check, names.py check and the tools tests pass

pullRequests.title: chore(ntsc): follow the NTSC decomp to 2d6fb52bb8
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: main
pullRequests.body: Moves the NTSC decomp pin from 6abcf077 to 2d6fb52b. Upstream renamed 2 boot functions and a few hundred level helpers (no header or layout changes, nothing newly matched); the names are adopted (config/names_ntsc.tsv, names.tsv, include/names.h, 600 definitions and 3734 uses renamed). All four versions build 20 of 20; version sync, fidelity, names and unit checks pass.

pullRequests.title: docs: credit the NTSC decomp's code as GPL-3.0
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: main
pullRequests.body:
The NTSC decomp is GPL-3.0 since its a1379f57, but the provenance comments in adapted code and the docs still said MIT. Comments only (206 files), no code changes.
Verified on box1: build_sn.sh audits 1241 of 1241 functions and the image matches retail; version_sync.py check, names.py check and gen_progress_report.py --check pass.
